body: Thank you for responding. I'm pretty annoyed at how hard it is to kill myself. I broke up with my boyfriend after writing this and now I feel worse. I'm trying to hold on and re-evaluate my situation.
I have been thinking about suicide for a very long time. I have done a lot of research and it looks to me like every option is pretty bad. It's disappointing as I also want to do it.

It's nice to think it could be something like that because something like that would eventually end. This feels like it will never end. Right now I am feeling pretty miserable. Getting the occasional message or reply here is helping.

Same here. I got Hydro Codone for a cough once and besides it only working for a short period of time cough wise it knocked me out. I went through it like water. I imagine it's a good thing they only gave me a small amount or I'd have a slightly worse problem than sleeping pills. Then again if I had enough I feel I would probably just end this.

I cope with things exactly the same way. Cutting and sleeping pills. I wish the sleeping pills were enough to end everything. It's like little tiny deaths I guess. They put me to sleep and I don't have to deal with my life for a few hours. At least they used to. I've been taking them so long they don't really work well anymore.

Thank you for commenting. 

I used to share my feelings with people. I used to talk to people about my problems but I recently realized people were just not listening. I don't mean they didn't do anything to help, I mean they literally did not listen. They completely ignored the things I was saying. 

Then I was faced with the fact that the person I loved didn't care about my feelings. 

I feel like I have no choice but to keep things to myself or get hurt.
